queries.costBasisPartsByPosition: SELECT p.id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" b WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" b WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0    AND (b.applied_executed_funds IS NULL OR b.applied_paid_fee IS NULL)), (SELECT SUM(b.applied_executed_funds + b.applied_paid_fee) FROM "order" b    WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0), (SELECT SUM(b.filled_quantity) FROM "order" b WHERE b.position_id = p.id AND b.side = 'BUY' AND b.filled_quantity > 0), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" s WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.side = 'SELL' AND s.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL    AND s.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL), (SELECT SUM(s.applied_executed_funds - s.applied_paid_fee) FROM "order" s    WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.side = 'SELL' AND s.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND s.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL), (SELECT SUM(s.filled_quantity) FROM "order" s    WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.side = 'SELL' AND s.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND s.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o WHERE o.position_id = p.id AND o.side = 'SELL' AND o.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL    AND NOT (o.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL AND o.applied_paid_fee IS NOT NULL AND o.filled_quantity IS NOT NULL AND o.filled_quantity > 0)), CASE WHEN ((COALESCE(p.exit_reason, '') = 'ENTRY_REJECTED' AND COALESCE(p.size, -1) = 0   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" nx WHERE nx.position_id = p.id)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" nb WHERE nb.position_id = p.id AND nb.side = 'BUY') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" nb WHERE nb.position_id = p.id AND nb.side = 'BUY'   AND NOT (COALESCE(nb.filled_quantity, 0) = 0 AND (nb.state = 'FAILED'     OR (nb.state = 'CANCELLED' AND (nb.fee_source IS NULL OR nb.cancel_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" ns WHERE ns.position_id = p.id AND ns.side = 'SELL'   AND ns.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM position p WHERE p.id IN (:ids)
queries.sumLiveSessionRealizedLossSince: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pnl), 0) FROM ( SELECT o.applied_executed_funds - o.applied_paid_fee - (o.filled_quantity * b.cost) / b.qty AS pnl FROM "order" o JOIN (SELECT bo.position_id, SUM(bo.applied_executed_funds + bo.applied_paid_fee) AS cost, SUM(bo.filled_quantity) AS qty FROM "order" bo WHERE bo.side = 'BUY' AND bo.position_id IS NOT NULL AND bo.filled_quantity > 0 GROUP BY bo.position_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(bo.applied_executed_funds) AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(bo.applied_paid_fee)) b ON b.position_id = o.position_id WHERE o.side = 'SELL' AND o.session_id IS NOT NULL AND o.session_kind = 'LIVE' AND o.sell_applied_at IS NOT NULL AND o.sell_applied_at >= :since AND o.applied_executed_funds IS NOT NULL AND o.applied_paid_fee IS NOT NULL AND o.filled_quantity IS NOT NULL AND o.filled_quantity > 0) t WHERE pnl < 0

findings.F1: ENTRY_REJECTED passes countsTowardStrategyPerformance; unfiltered LogAnalyzer row count includes it and lossCount classifies zero as loss. Source observation, not engine reproduction.
findings.F2: Prior production ExitReason has no ENTRY_REJECTED while PositionEntity uses EnumType.STRING. Old-binary entity hydration compatibility is a static risk; not run against old jar.
findings.F3: CONFIRMED_NO_TRADE coalesces NULL BUY filled_quantity to zero, including CANCELLED with cancel_confirmed_at. Exact SQL counterexample above; PG reproduction required before treating it as confirmed no-trade.
